legacy-backward-compat.sectionTitle: CRITICAL: Legacy and backward compatibility are NEVER permissible
legacy-backward-compat.instructions: Findings in this report (deprecation, legacy markers, backward-compatibility accommodation) are NEVER permissible. They are HIGH refactor targets. Do not allowlist them in config; the goal is to eliminate these patterns or migrate off the legacy path. Scores are weighted so that legacy/compat findings produce high numeric values and high priority (P0/P1).
